properties.name: Dry Run
properties.description: True: investigate, ask for approval and report what would be done, but change nothing. Set to false only after a dry run looked right.

properties.name: Audit Only
properties.description: True: investigate and write the assessment to the incident worklog, but raise no approval task and change nothing. For tuning the rule that starts the workflow.

properties.name: Observables
properties.description: Optional. Observables to assess when the workflow is started by hand, one per line or separated by commas.

properties.name: Maximum Observables
properties.description: Observables assessed per run (1 to 50). The rest is reported, not assessed.

properties.name: Collect Sightings
properties.description: False skips the sightings query, for incidents whose sightings are too large.

properties.name: Internal Domain Suffixes
properties.description: Comma-separated DNS suffixes of your own hosts and mail domains (corp.example.com, example.com). A dotted name under one of them is an endpoint; any other dotted name is a domain. When set, account actions are proposed only for addresses under them.

properties.name: Protected Assets
properties.description: Comma-separated names or patterns (DC-*, ceo@example.com, @finance.example) that always need elevated approval.

properties.name: Never Act On
properties.description: Comma-separated values, patterns or networks that are never proposed (your own domains, resolvers, break-glass accounts, 203.0.113.0/24). A domain also covers its subdomains.

properties.name: Excluded Actions
properties.description: Comma-separated action kinds this run must not propose: isolate_endpoint, block_indicator.

properties.name: Trust Analyst Selection
properties.description: True: an endpoint, account or message a person chose is proposed even when no indicator of the incident is rated high enough. The approval is still required.

properties.name: Block Unrated Indicators
properties.description: True: a domain, URL, address or hash that no module rates is proposed for blocking when a person started the workflow with it. An indicator rated clean is never proposed.

properties.name: Elevated Approval Above
properties.description: More proposed actions than this need elevated approval.

properties.name: Isolate Action Pattern
properties.description: Text of the XDR response action used for isolate_endpoint (regular expression on its title, case-insensitive). The decision card lists the titles on offer when nothing matches.

properties.name: Block Action Pattern
properties.description: Text of the XDR response action used for block_indicator (regular expression on its title, case-insensitive). The decision card lists the titles on offer when nothing matches.

Nothing is changed without that approval, and nothing is changed while Dry Run is true.
